title: Correção de rótulos de créditos legados
scope: Correção de dois rótulos de créditos legados publicada via Reviewer oficial em 2026-11-05; ambos os candidatos mantêm Copyfit V3 EXACT 1/1 em 100% e 200%.

candidates.label: tile-and-token-art

100%.method: scripts/measure_copyfit_page.mjs: PyMuPDF text spans grouped by actual span baseline (1 pt tolerance), so one visual row split around an inline object remains one row even when per-run bbox centres differ; live PT-BR PageRenderer text rects plus visible semantic-symbol rects for symbol-only rows are clustered by vertical centre (0.5 x median rect height). Inline symbols overlapping a text row are counted with that row, not as extra lines. Candidate text and symbol IDs must match the selected renderer unit. No character count, string newline count or frame-height estimate was used.

pageRendererEvidence.readingMethod: text rects of the review-highlighted unit plus visible semantic-symbol rects for symbol-only rows

100%.editorialStatus: Pending human editorial approval; Copyfit V3 measurement does not approve or publish the translation. Not visually reviewed by a human.
